title: Page 136
transc:
Hd Qrs Genl Butler May 20 . 1864
Maj Eckert Di  10 PM
from snake may harsh Rebecca for fender
zebra dispatch received zodiac I have sent
the burn side two launches I manifest
spit to aid in scouring the amen
she will be there in harsh penny
hours walrus Knox brisk work down here
R. OBrien


Hd Qrs Gen Butler May 20 1864
10 P. M
Maj Eckert Di
from snake may harsh Rebecca for Bruno
zebra have been ravishing all day Rome
are endeavoring to close in on our
lines zodiac me shall hold on zebra
have captured walpole shelby Walker of ague 
whist zebra nabob is at while house
and has sent for a village patent
which I have forwarded him have also
sent one of my opal sharons with
launches up the amen as requested Knox
R OBrien


War Dep't May 20 1864
Geo D Sheldon & R OBrien
add to the list of Extra arbitraries in
no plug penfield the words mackerel and mutton
for tappan Shelby D Hunter zebra acknowledge receipt
TT Eckert
